title: Russian-provoked incident causing casualties on NATO territory could be red line for Alliance – Rinkēvičs
summary: An incident provoked by Russia that results in casualties on the territory of a NATO member state could constitute a red line for the Alliance.

title: SBU detains hairdresser in Sloviansk suspected of directing Russian strikes
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) has detained a woman suspected of directing Russian strikes on Sloviansk.

title: War update: 151 clashes along the front line; 40 Russian troops killed on Pokrovsk axis
summary: On November 25, Ukrainian forces reported 151 combat engagements along the front line, including 18 Russian attacks repelled in the Pokrovsk sector.

title: Russian forces drop two aerial bombs on Sloviansk, killing one person, injuring another
summary: Russian forces dropped two 250-kilogram aerial bombs on the city of Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one man and injuring another.

title: Russia’s November losses in Ukraine already top 55,000, setting new wartime record – General Staff
summary: The Russian military has suffered its highest monthly losses of the entire war, losing 55,629 troops in the first 25 days of November.

title: Trump and Rutte urge Putin not to expand war in Ukraine
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte issued a joint statement following their meeting in Florida on November 25, calling on Russia to refrain from actions that could expand the war against Ukraine.

title: U.S. Department of State approves possible sale of F-16 equipment to Ukraine
summary: The U.S. Department of State has approved the possible sale to Ukraine of equipment and maintenance services for F-16 fighter jets.

title: North Korea suspends military aid to Russia, including ballistic missile dupplies – DIU
summary: North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui has announced the suspension of military support for the Russian Federation, with the decision personally made by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

title: Russian attacks on Kherson region kill one person and injure another in past 24 hours
summary: In the Kherson region, one person was killed and another injured as a result of Russian aggression.

title: Russian attacks on Kharkiv region kill four people and injure six in past 24 hours
summary: Over the past 24 hours, on 25 November, Kharkiv and 13 other settlements in the Kharkiv region came under Russian attack; four people were killed and a further six were injured.

title: 167 clashes reported along front line in past 24 hours, with Pokrovsk sector remaining hottest spot
summary: Over the past 24 hours, on 25 November, 167 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front line, with the Pokrovsk sector remaining the hottest.

title: Russian forces launch 20 drone attacks on four districts in Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring one person
summary: Since the evening of 25 November, Russian forces have launched nearly 20 drone attacks on four districts in the Dnipropetrovsk region, leaving one person injured.

title: Drone strike on high-rise building in Kharkiv kills two people
summary: In the Novobavarskyi district of Kharkiv, two people were killed when a Russian drone struck a multi-storey residential block on the morning of 26 November.

title: Russia loses another 2,319 troops and four aircraft in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
summary: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from 24 February 2022 to 26 November 2026, amount to approximately 1,645,899 personnel, of whom 2,319 were lost in the past 24 hours.

title: 37,000 civilians remain in Kramatorsk and Sloviansk communities
summary: In the Donetsk region, 37,000 civilians currently remain in the Kramatorsk and Sloviansk municipal communities.

title: Dutch FM discusses Russia’s war against Ukraine during visit to China
summary: The Dutch Foreign Minister, Tom Berendsen, met with Ding Xuexiang, Vice-Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China, in Beijing, during which they discussed bilateral relations and Russia’s war in Ukraine.

title: EU–Western Balkans summit participants reaffirm support for Ukraine
summary: At a summit in the Belgian capital, European Union leaders, in consultation with their partners from the Western Balkans, adopted the Brussels Declaration, in which they reaffirmed their firm support for Ukraine against the backdrop of Russian aggression.

title: Ukraine, Hungary planning first meeting of Commission on National Minorities for early 2027
summary: Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister Vsevolod Chentsov and Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán will co-chair the Ukrainian-Hungarian Intergovernmental Commission on National Minorities, with its first meeting scheduled for early 2027.

title: Ukrainian documentaries Traces and The Last Message eligible for 99th Academy Awards
summary: Two Ukrainian documentaries, Traces and The Last Message, have been accepted for consideration at the 99th Academy Awards.

title: Melania Trump helps reunite nine more children separated from their families by Russia's war against Ukraine
summary: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump has helped reunite another group of children with their families after they were separated by Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: Finance Ministry raises UAH 2.09 bln from domestic bond auction
summary: Ukraine's Ministry of Finance raised UAH 2.09 billion for the state budget at an auction of domestic government bonds held on November 24, 2026.

title: Perceptions of Ukraine in Türkiye have changed significantly over past decade – scholar
summary: Over the past decade, perceptions of Ukraine in Turkey have changed significantly: growing numbers of people are taking an interest in its culture and history and learning the Ukrainian language. This is important for developing strategic relations between the two countries.

title: Zelensky warns Russia is preparing new large-scale attack
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on Ukrainians to pay close attention to air-raid sirens in the coming days, following reports that Russia is preparing a new large-scale attack.

title: Russian forces strike factory in Khmelnytskyi region
summary: In the Khmelnytskyi district, a fire broke out on the premises of one of the enterprises as a result of a Russian attack.

title: Ukraine invites Canada to join War Risk Insurance Fund
summary: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has invited Canada to contribute to the War Risk Insurance Fund, which is due to be launched in January. Ukraine is also counting on an expansion of Canada’s preferential lending schemes and the attraction of investment into the private sector.

title: Dnipropetrovsk region comes under more than 50 attacks in one day, causing damage
summary: Russian invaders launched more than fifty drone attacks on the Kryvyi Rih and Nikopol districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day.

title: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia kills one, injures four
summary: Today, 26 November, Russian troops attacked Zaporizhzhia.

title: President Zelensky thanks Americans for their support in Thanksgiving message
summary: Ukraine remains strong thanks to the support of many American friends.

title: Ukraine hits Russian refinery in Krasnodar Krai, setting fire to key facilities
summary: Drones of the Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU) attacked an oil refinery in the city of Slavyansk-on-Kuban in Russia’s Krasnodar Krai overnight on November 26.

title: China may seek U.S. concessions on Taiwan in exchange for pressuring Russia – expert
summary: China may have an interest in ending the Russian-Ukrainian war to preserve its economic ties with Europe, while expecting concessions from the United States on Taiwan in return.

title: Ukrainian aviation strikes Russian troop hub in Huliaipole
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces carried out an airstrike on a Russian troop staging point in Huliaipole, Zaporizhzhia region.

title: Ukrinform featured on interactive Map of Recommended Media
summary: A total of 317 Ukrainian media outlets, including Ukrinform, have been added to the interactive Map of Recommended Media for the second half of 2026.

title: Ukraine receives $450 mln from World Bank with Japanese government support
summary: Ukraine has received $450 million from the World Bank, backed by guarantees from the Japanese government, under two programs: RISE, to support businesses, and SURGE, to support reconstruction.

title: Russian plans to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk by winter completely foiled – military
summary: Russian forces had planned to reach Kramatorsk and Sloviansk before the start of winter, but actions by Ukraine’s Defense Forces have forced them to focus on stabilizing their own positions rather than advancing further.

title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to eight, one killed
summary: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kharkiv has risen to eight, while one person was killed.

title: Russia may stage new provocations against Poland during Christmas holidays – General Kraszewski
summary: Russia may step up provocations against Poland ahead of the Christmas and New Year holidays, when public attention is focused on the festivities.

title: Mother of fallen U.S. volunteer hopes to publish in Ukraine children’s book inspired by her son
summary: Laura Racy Miller, the mother of U.S. volunteer Hayden Fisher Miller, who was killed defending Ukraine, hopes to publish her children’s book Night of the Cricket in Ukraine. Inspired by her son, the story follows a cricket overcoming obstacles on its way to achieving its dream.

title: Bodies of 250 fallen Ukrainians repatriated from Russia
summary: The bodies of 250 deceased people have been returned to Ukraine. Russia claims they are those of Ukrainian service members.

title: Ukraine strikes Russian airfield and Transneft oil hub
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Marinovka airfield in Russia’s Volgograd region with Neptune missiles overnight on November 26. A hit was also recorded at a Transneft oil pumping station in Bashkortostan, more than 1,000 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.

title: Zelensky: Russia preparing for another massive attack on Ukraine
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said Russian forces were completing preparations for another massive attack, with energy infrastructure, logistics and essential services likely to be targeted again.

title: Russian strike kills four police investigators in Zaporizhzhia
summary: Four investigators from the unit handling particularly serious crimes within the Main Directorate of the National Police in the Zaporizhzhia region were killed in a Russian attack on the city of Zaporizhzhia.

title: Kushner blames Ukraine for stalling peace talks over ‘attack on Putin’s house’ in 2025
summary: Jared Kushner, U.S .President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, has claimed that Ukraine is responsible for the delays in peace negotiations with Russia.

title: Russian drone hits university building in Kharkiv, killing woman
summary: A Russian jet-powered drone struck a university building in Kharkiv’s Kyivskyi district, killing a woman.

title: Hungary to join International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children
summary: Hungary has decided to join the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children. This means that all 27 European Union member states are now part of the Coalition.
